content: अप्रतिष्ठ {%a.%} .²1 Not stable or firmly fixed, fluctuating, not made permanent; अप्रतिष्ठे रघुज्येष्ठे का प्रतिष्ठा कुलस्य नः <ls>U. 5. 25</ls>. .²2 Thrown away, unprofitable, useless; अप्रतिष्ठं तु वार्धुषौ <ls>Ms. 3. 180</ls>. .²3 Disreputable, infamous. .²4 Without support, adjustment; असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम् <ls>Bg. 16. 8</ls>. .{@-ष्ठः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a hell. .{@-ष्ठा@} Instability, ill-fame, ill-repute, dishonour. .{@-ष्ठम्@} Brahman (स्वधामप्रतिष्ठितं ब्रह्म).
